audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 4 and 6 disagreed with the already-audited mirror (kayle__ksante) and with this page's own prose: win[1] said Kayle while whys[1] says 'I edge this farming window'; win[4] said Skill while whys[4] says Divine Judgment negates the whole R; win[6] said Kayle while whys[6] calls teamfights 'my one reclaim'.
audit.why: 44.41% over 948 games; the mirror set rows 1/4/6 to K'Sante, Kayle, K'Sante and left Levels 4-5 at Skill. Both directions must print the same names.
audit.corrected: phases[1].side + win[1] -> K'Sante, phases[4].side + win[4] -> Kayle, phases[6].side + win[6] -> K'Sante, proposed as matched pairs with inverted ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice: Divine Judgment was described only as 'her get-out at 6' with no number, so a reader has no idea how long the untargetable window is off.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s — the longest cooldown in the lane and the single thing that voids All Out. Starfire Spellblade is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s and Celestial Blessing a flat 15s.
audit.corrected: 160/120/80s written into the interactions row and the cooldown block, Starfire Spellblade's 8s and Celestial Blessing's 15s added where they change a decision.

audit.whatIsWrong: (1) 'Q3 knock-up' / 'Q3-knockup' in three writable paths — Ntofo Strikes has no knockup; at 2 stacks it fires a shockwave that PULLS. (2) 'eat the unstoppable charge' — Riot's Path Maker text says reduced damage taken, not unstoppable. (3) Kayle called 'he/his' in four rows.
audit.why: Kit text is the authority; unstoppable status is not in the file, so it is unknown and must not be asserted.
audit.corrected: Pull corrected everywhere, W described as charging through her damage into the knock-back stun, pronouns fixed. Divine Judgment's untargetable interaction with the R dash confirmed correct and given its number. Starfire Spellblade's auto-attack reset added as the burst tell, and Grievous Wounds tied to Celestial Blessing.
sources: kit: Kayle R untargetable, E autoReset, W heal

edits.before: Chain Q slows on Kayle, Q3-knockup when his answer is down, W through the return damage, and decide: peel out or All Out.
edits.after: Chain Q slows on Kayle, two-stack Ntofo pull when Divine Judgment is down, W through the return damage, then peel out or All Out.

edits.before: Track Kayle's Divine Judgment (Invuln): Her get-out at 6. Bait it. When it is down — Q3-R her.
edits.after: Divine Judgment (160s at rank 1) makes her untargetable — your R dash whiffs clean through it.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: 160/120/80s — untargetable, so your R dash whiffs straight through it. Her burst opens with a Starfire Spellblade auto reset (8s at rank 1): step back on the wind-up, not on the cast.

edits.before: That is Kayle's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Free farm is her entire win condition — deny CS and XP or she simply outscales you.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the Q-slow engine), then Sunfire Aegis / Kaenic Rookern; boots Mercury's Treads. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet, then Kaenic Rookern for her on-hit magic; boots Mercury's Treads. Bring Grievous Wounds early — Celestial Blessing (15s) heals her out of every grind trade.

edits.before: Your full Q-W combo comes online — W her in as she walks up to last-hit with melee autos and Q3 knock-up, your one clean trade before she has range.
edits.after: Your full Q-W combo comes online — W her as she steps up to melee last-hit, then the two-stack Ntofo pull, your one clean trade before she has range at all.

edits.before: Reach level 3 and W a stepped-up Kayle into a Q3 knock-up before she gets her E ranged form
edits.after: Reach level 3 and W a stepped-up Kayle into the two-stack Ntofo pull before her ranged form

edits.before: Kayle is melee and miserable Levels 1-2, but so am I — I only have Q at level 1 and no engage, so I just farm and avoid feeding her any free CS-denial leverage. The real window is level 3: once my Q-W combo is up, I W into her the instant she steps forward to melee-last-hit, eat the unstoppable charge into a knock-back-stun, and Q3 to knock her up. That's my one honest trade in this lane, so make it count and call my jungler — she has no escape and no range yet.
edits.after: Kayle is melee and miserable Levels 1-2, but so am I — I only have Q at level 1 and no engage, so I just farm and avoid feeding her any free CS-denial leverage. The real window is level 3: once my Q-W combo is up, I W into her the instant she steps forward to melee-last-hit, charging through her damage into the knock-back stun, then land the two-stack Ntofo pull. That's my one honest trade, so make it count and call my jungler — she has no escape and no range yet.

notes: Divine Judgment negating the R dash was already correct and is now backed by its 160/120/80s number. Kayle's Radiant Blast also reduces resistances, which matters more to a tank than to anyone else, but no writable path had room for it inside the length band without cutting something more decisive — flagged as a gap rather than forced in. Levels 4-5 left at Skill to match the mirror, not the packet's Kayle.
